messages:
yvonne: Summarizing DR postmortem follow-ups so owners can pick up items. Root causes we saw: uneven BGP withdraws that split traffic, two AZs with missing backup manifests, and unclear temporary ownership during the warm-standby drill. I'll list owners + short ETAs. Reply with changes.

diego: I'll take F1 (withdraw tuning + deploy gating). Plan: add a 9s withdraw grace, relax healthcheck sensitivity, and add a deploy-sim that kills 1 region. ETA 2026-04-13, ticket OPS-6233.

sam: I'll own F2 (backup manifest QA). Adding a nightly checksum job and a weekday quick-restore to staging. ETA 2026-03-30, job=JENK-1215.

nora: I'll do F3 (restore handoff doc + checklist). Add a clear oncall handoff table and one-command helper for VIP bind + DB readonly toggle. Draft at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-handoff ETA 2026-04-04.

kevin: I'll coordinate game-day cadence: two table-top rehearsals the next two Tuesdays, then a full warm failover for ap-southeast on 2026-04-23. pager-bot: reminder set -> "DR tabletop" 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC (owner: kevin)

diego: snippet I'll reference in the RFC to avoid aggressive withdrawals:
```bash
# withdraw grace and healthcheck
bgp withdraw-grace 9
set http-check timeout 12s
```

sam: tagging telemetry failure_mode=partial-withdraw and will add a dashboard panel for daily restore success rate. Will also alert on manifest-mismatch.

nora: adding pre-restore checklist to the runbook with exact commands so oncall doesn't guess. Example step: verify KMS access and snapshot manifest present before starting.

kevin: action snapshot from thread:
- F1 withdraw tuning: owner=diego, ETA=2026-04-13, ticket=OPS-6233
- F2 manifest QA: owner=sam, ETA=2026-03-30, job=JENK-1215
- F3 runbook + handoff: owner=nora, ETA=2026-04-04, doc=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-handoff

yvonne: please update this thread with status changes. I will convert to the shared tracker after the first updates so PMs can follow.

diego: ack :thumbsup:

sam: ack

nora: ack

kevin: closing thread for now. I'll post weekly Monday updates until all items are closed. Reopen if blockers appear.
